source.manual: SA38-0667 z/OS MVS System Management Facilities (SMF)

fields.description: Record length. This field and the next field (total of four bytes) form the record descriptor word (RDW). See Standard and extended SMF record headers for a detailed description.
Segment descriptor (see record length field). This is zero, if the record is not spanned.

System indicator flags Bit Meaning when set 0 Subsystem identification follows system identification. 1 Subtypes are used 2 Reserved 3-6 Version indicators* 7 Reserved. *See Standard and extended SMF record headers for a detailed description.
Record type 42 (X'2A').
Time since midnight, in hundredths of a second, when the record was moved into the SMF buffer.
Date when the record was moved into the SMF buffer, in the form 0cyydddF. See Standard and extended SMF record headers for a detailed description.
